notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are supported. The two upper-cabinet leaves are opened and closed separately in rapid succession; their exact closing order around frames 592-608 is the main uncertainty. The initial traversal through frame 104 contains no specific state-changing manipulation.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens the refrigerator, opens both leaves of the cabinet above the range hood, then opens a drawer beside the stove. The refrigerator, cabinet leaves, and drawer are subsequently closed.
